needed.suggestion: Create a proper sidewalk on the left side to improve pedestrian safety.
Remove obstructions from the left sidewalk to ensure it remains usable.
Repair uneven sections on the left footway to prevent trips.
Install a marked pedestrian crossing where people have to cross.
Enhance visibility of the crossing area for safety.
Install a refuge island if pedestrian traffic is high.
Add dropped kerbs at the crossing for better pedestrian flow.
Install street lights along the road to improve visibility.
